posts.trend: India’s Business Activity Hits Four Month High in October, but Hiring Remains Flat
posts.context: Corporate leadership announces milestone growth publicly while freezing internal team budgets.
posts.angle: The company celebrates record expansion on LinkedIn while keeping your increment under review.
slides: Record profits this quarter. Increment budget is still under review.

LinkedIn post — 'Record quarter!'
Town hall — 'Macroeconomic headwinds.'
Manager — 'Thoda adjust kar lo.'
HR — 'Band revision in Q4.'
The Q4 deck is already printed.
posts.caption: Send this to the colleague who prepared fifty slides for a two percent hike.
posts.rank_verdict: The corporate hypocrisy trope is too familiar and lacks a punchy comedic turn.
